crossRefs.note: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against Yahweh; and be sure your sin will find you out.
Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the…
This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill…
With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward…
by the lot of their inheritance, as Yahweh commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.
For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan; but to the Levites he gave…

people.name: Gad
people.line: Israelite tribe; descended from Gad, son of Jacob.

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.
translations.bsb: For the tribes of the Reubenites and Gadites, along with the half-tribe of Manasseh, have already received their inheritance.
translations.kjv: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
translations.asv: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers' houses, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers' houses, have received, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received, their inheritance:
